ashby:airwallex:34d5ea3b-08f0-465d-967b-.summary:
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told…

bullets: Acquire new strategic customers across North America, with a focus on Fortune 100 and Fortune 500 companies, through your existing network and industry relationships.
Own and drive sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from ideation and prospecting through negotiation, closing, onboarding, and expansion.

Work collaboratively with colleagues across sales, product, engineering, solutions consulting, strategy, finance, legal, and implementation.

An established network of senior decision-makers and influencers responsible for payments, financial operations, treasury, or related functions at Fortune 500 companies or organizations of comparable scale.
Demonstrated experience selling API-driven or technically complex solutions with meaningful integration requirements.

ashby:baseten:36f9e1be-a876-478b-b7ce-fa.summary: Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F , led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

sections.title: PRODUCT AT BASETEN
paras: Baseten is building a new cloud for AI. Our ambition is to make inference, training, and agent execution part of one coherent platform, and to shape how the next generation of AI products gets built. Product decisions here reach from the economics of GPU infrastructure to the abstractions developers build on every day.

We’re hiring builders and tastemakers with the ambition to help create that future. You should bring a strong point of view about what should exist, the taste to make complex technology feel simple, and the technical judgment to build it alongside engineers, researchers, and designers. You’ll work directly with customers and forward deployed teams, turn emerging capabilities into new possibilities for developers, and carry an idea from early conviction through to production and adoption.

sections.title: Make AI inference faster, smarter, and more efficient at scale.
paras: Making AI models faster and cheaper is one of the most important engineering challenges in the industry. But a faster runtime alone isn't enough. Customers need to understand what improved, whether it works for their models, and how to take advantage of it in production.

We're looking for a deeply technical Product Manager to work alongside our inference engineers and researchers, turning advances in model serving and performance into capabilities customers can confidently adopt.
You'll help bridge the gap between cutting-edge systems engineering and real-world production workloads.

sections.title: RESPONSIBILITIES
bullets: Work with inference engineering and research teams to bring new performance capabilities to customers.
Translate advances in batching, caching, quantization, speculative decoding, and serving architectures into useful product features.
Define benchmarks and evaluations that demonstrate meaningful improvements in latency, throughput, quality, and cost.
Understand customer workloads and help prioritize the optimizations that will have the greatest impact.
Make performance features easier to configure, evaluate, and adopt in production.
Help customers understand tradeoffs across hardware, model configurations, autoscaling, and routing.
Partner with engineering on release readiness, compatibility, and regression testing so customers can trust new capabilities.

sections.title: REQUIREMENTS
bullets: Experience building and shipping AI/ML products or infrastructure, particularly where performance, scalability, or production behavior mattered.
A technical background in software engineering, ML engineering, research, or equivalent hands-on experience.
Strong understanding of model serving architectures, GPU economics, and latency, throughput, quality, and cost tradeoffs.
Experience working closely with researchers or infrastructure engineers to bring technically complex capabilities into production.
A rigorous approach to benchmarking, experimentation, and performance measurement.
Strong product judgment and the ability to translate deep technical work into clear customer value.

ashby:benchling:ce76248e-0453-49a5-8f92-.summary:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is…

sections.title: ROLE OVERVIEW
paras: Benchling believes in putting our customers at the center of everything we do. We strive to provide an exceptional experience for our customers and our users from the first touchpoint, through our implementations, and once they are live.

We take pride in how we support the industry and Customer Success is an essential part of this equation. To keep up with our rapidly expanding growth, we are building a team of Customer Success Managers with experience in Life Sciences, who can help advise customers, develop our processes, and drive execution.

Our Customer Success Management (CSM) team works alongside our Professional Services, Product, and Sales teams to help customers enhance the value of their Benchling investments. Customer Success Managers deeply understand the customer's science, business goals, and Benchling deployment. They ensure customers achieve maximum value by promoting best practices, maximizing adoption – including Benchling AI adoption - and aligning customer deployments with their strategic objectives.

Create and execute product telemetry programs that keep customers one step ahead, boosting adoption, value realization, and achieving business objectives.

bullets: Become the go-to advisor on the Benchling platform — know its features, AI capabilities, value drivers, and best practices.
Get to know our customers’ science, industry trends, and big goals
Use this expertise to guide customers toward key outcomes and maximize their success.

Drive projects like customer journey mapping and voice-of-customer feedback to make every interaction unforgettable.
Own and deliver Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) that showcase value realization, deployment health, customer maturity, and alignment to Benchling's product roadmap.

ashby:column:32435cfe-91d7-485e-9558-dcc.summary: For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.

sections.title: About Column
paras: At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!

sections.title: The opportunity:
paras:
As a Solutions Engineer at Column, you'll partner with tech-forward companies to build financial products and solutions using Column's APIs. This is a highly cross-functional role: you'll work closely with engineering, business, operations, legal, and compliance teams to support customer implementations and expand customer activity on Column—directly contributing to the growth of our business.

This role is more technically demanding than the average Solutions Engineering position. You'll need to develop a deep understanding of our platform and APIs to serve as a trusted technical partner to customers. Beyond customer implementation, you'll gather and synthesize customer feedback, identify product gaps, and help shape new product requirements, working directly with our engineering team to drive product development.

You'll also be responsible for building internal tools and automation to improve our team's operational efficiency. You will have significant opportunities to expand your scope and take on additional responsibility as you grow.

This role is based in our Presidio office in San Francisco and follows a four-day, in-person schedule. You will report to Column's Head of Solution Engineering.

bullets: Support the technical relationship with our customers across pre-sales, implementation, onboarding, and support.
Assist with the implementation and delivery of strategic cross-functional projects with guidance from senior team members.
Leverage AI to build internal tooling and processes to address operational bottlenecks
Collect and organize product feedback, help identify gaps, and support the writing of product requirement documents.
Learn to manage roadmap expectations with our engineering team and customers.
Perform day-to-day activities consistent with safe and sound business practices and regulatory requirements.
Help identify, assess, and manage risk by adhering to policies and procedures established by the Bank, and report issues to management.

ashby:eliza:056e1bab-e010-4818-b247-6ffc.summary: We are a technology services company dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions. From generative AI and custom LLM integrations to predictive analytics and intelligent automation, we work across industries to bring real-world AI applications to life. Our projects combine deep technical expertise with hands-on client collaboration to solve high-impact problems.

sections.title: Job Summary
paras: The Senior AI Deployment Manager leads complex AI product and delivery work in Eliza's Cyber vertical. You will serve as the product counterpart to client leaders and business development, translating cybersecurity needs into feasible AI opportunities and owning delivery alignment from discovery through launch. You will work closely with forward-deployed engineers, owning product decisions while engineering partners own implementation decisions in their lane.

This is a founding role in the Cyber vertical. You will operate independently through ambiguity, set direction for client work and teammates, and stay close enough to delivery to keep commitments and outcomes credible. Engagements may include cyber-domain discovery and, when the work calls for it, training on AI governance and Codex setup.

Eliza is AI-native and expects leaders to use AI tools in discovery, product definition, and client communication. The technology and client context evolve quickly; sound judgment means knowing where AI is useful, where it is not, and when to bring engineering or domain expertise into a decision.

sections.title: 1. Scope cyber opportunities and prioritize use cases
bullets: Run structured discovery with cyber stakeholders to understand workflows, risk, data readiness, and business outcomes.
Assess use-case fit, feasibility, sequencing, and the path to production; make clear recommendations on what is ready for AI and what is not.
Build and maintain a prioritized use-case backlog grounded in feasibility, readiness, and measurable impact.

sections.title: 2. Own product definition and delivery alignment
bullets: Translate client needs into product requirements, acceptance evidence, delivery plans, and product roadmaps engineers can act on.
Partner with forward-deployed engineers through design, evaluation, iteration, launch, and handoff; surface edge cases and risks early.
Manage the gap between prototype and production, including data quality, security, compliance, and scalability concerns.

sections.title: 3. Own outcomes and stakeholder trust
bullets: Align client executives, subject-matter experts, business development, and technical teams on scope, tradeoffs, timing, and measurable value.

ashby:healthleap:f84a1776-ae77-4e01-8aea.summary:
Every day, millions of hospitalized patients who need intervention are missed because clinicians simply can't see everything. Healthleap is building the AI operating system that helps care teams identify these missed patients, enabling them to improve health outcomes and generate millions of dollars. Healthleap is changing what is possible: closing gaps that traditional workflows and clinician capacity could never.

Over the past year, we've grown contracted revenue more than 13x, expanded rapidly across leading health systems, and now help care teams identify patients across millions of inpatient encounters.

We've raised $38M, backed by Sequoia, First Round and Hummingbird. SF-based and in person. And we're delivering results that are changing lives.

sections.title: The problem space
paras: By the time a patient is admitted to the hospital, their medical chart already holds about 95,000 words of notes - about six hours of reading - and every touchpoint from a clinician adds more. Doctors, nurses, and other clinicians walking into the room have a few minutes to synthesize what has changed, decide what the patient needs and what to check next, and move to the next room.

To know who needs them most, clinicians rely on a screening checklist filled in at admission, alongside static, rules-based alerts. On day one, standard screening catches only about 1 in 4 of the patients who need care. The other patients are caught later, after their condition worsens; by then, they heal more slowly and stay longer in the hospital.

sections.title: What Healthleap has built
paras: Healthleap’s AI reads every hospitalized patient’s full record, every day, and finds the patients who need care about four days earlier than standard screening.

Patients Healthleap flags are twice as likely to need care as those found by standard screening. Leading health systems including Cedars-Sinai, Penn Medicine, Emory, and others have measured that these patients heal faster and go home sooner, which frees beds for the next patient.
Hospitals stay and grow with us: we have 0 churn and have expanded from 3 to 50 hospitals in the last year. After seeing the results, our hospital partners have asked us to take on more use cases.

sections.title: Who you’ll work with

sections.title: What you will do
paras: As a founding member of Healthleap’s product team, you’ll report directly to our CEO to stand up the next use case on our platform. You’ll have access to enthusiastic development-partner hospitals, best-in-class technology and the data access to build quickly.
bullets: Take the next use case from day one to deployed workflow: work alongside the founding team and our development partners, define the problem and the solution, build a prototype within weeks, run the pilot, and scale it across our hospital partners within months.
Pick the right problems to solve for clinicians and other users who are hard to reach.
Define what success looks like before the pilot starts, and set the bar for accuracy and clinical safety with our clinicians and data scientists.
Validate assumptions fast, with data you pull yourself and prototypes you build.

Turn what you learn into the playbook for every use case after yours.

Make Delivery Reliable : Lead delivery incident response and root-cause analysis, triage technical blockers to the right owners, and track corrective actions to resolution so the same issue never recurs.

ashby:simile:5e7d7e4d-7a66-45be-9ad5-cfe.summary:
Pilots don't train with real passengers. Actors don't rehearse with real audiences. Yet, the most consequential decisions in society are often pushed straight to production.

Simile is changing that. We have built the first AI simulation of society, populated by generative agents based on real humans. Our research pioneered the field of AI-based simulation, proving it is possible to model human behavior with high accuracy. Today, we are developing a Foundation Model to predict human behavior in any situation, at any scale.

We have raised $300M in total funding, with a $2B post-money valuation in our latest round. Our investors include Greenoaks, Index Ventures, Hanabi, A*, Bain Capital Ventures, Factory, CVS Health Ventures, and Definition.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As a Product Manager on Data Products, you will own how real human signal makes its way into Simile. Every simulation we run depends on the data behind it. Data Products owns the products that collect, structure, protect, and activate that data. That includes our in-house AI interview platform, which runs real-time, adaptive conversations with people at scale. It also includes the experiences that let the world's most security-conscious organizations bring their own data to Simile with confidence.

You'll work across engineering, research, security, and go-to-market to decide what we build and why. You'll be involved from the first customer conversation through the spec, the launch, and the iteration after real usage tells you what you got wrong.

sections.title: In this role, you will:
bullets: Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define the vision and roadmap for Data Products. Decide where to invest across data collection, data integration, and data quality, and make clear tradeoffs between what customers ask for and what will matter most for simulation accuracy.

Data Collection: Own the product direction for our AI interview platform, from the participant experience and interview design tooling to the structured outputs that feed our models. Raise the quality, depth, and scale of what we learn from every conversation.

Enterprise Data Experiences: Design the workflows that let customers connect, share, and manage their data with Simile. Make them simple enough for a business user and rigorous enough to pass an enterprise security review.

Trust, Privacy & Governance: Treat security and privacy as core product requirements. Partner with engineering, security, and legal on consent, access controls, PII handling, retention, data residency, and auditability, and turn them into clear product decisions and customer-facing commitments.

Customer Discovery: Talk to customers, research partners, and internal users regularly. Understand their data landscape, their security concerns, and the questions they need answered, and bring that back into prioritization.

Cross-Functional Execution: Write crisp specs, set success metrics, and run launches with engineering, research, design, and sales. Make sure field teams can explain what the product does, how data is protected, and why it improves results.
Measurement & Iteration: Define what "good data" means at Simile, including coverage, quality, freshness, and impact on simulation accuracy, and use it to guide what we build next.

Quantitative Literacy: Comfort with data quality, sampling, measurement, and experimentation. Enough to define metrics that hold up when a customer's data science team questions them.
Product Instincts: Strong judgment about what to build, what not to build, and how to sequence it, with the customer's problem always at the center.
Exceptional Communication: You can turn complex technical and privacy topics into clear specs, narratives, and decisions for engineers, executives, and customers alike.

greenhouse:pilothq:8880563002.summary:
Meridian is the AI operating system for accounting firms, built by Pilot.

We built it the hard way, inside our own firm while closing more 200,000 months of books for more than 8,000 businesses. Along the way, we’ve worked through the odd vendors, miscategorized deposits and multi-currency messes that drag out a close. Today, Meridian brings that experience to other accounting firms.

It automates the full month-end close, from reconciliation, categorization, and accruals to tick-and-tie, so controllers walk in on the first of the month to review finished books, not build them. That changes the math for the whole practice. A firm that stops building the close can rebuild how it delivers the work and keep a lot more of every fixed fee.

sections.title: About Meridian
paras: The next challenge is helping firms put Meridian to work. Accounting is deciding what AI should and shouldn’t touch, with plenty of accountants who are skeptical. Our job is to show them what this looks like when it works, one close at a time.

That takes people who listen closely, understand the work and follow through. We’re still early in bringing Meridian to other firms. Joining now means helping shape the product, how firms adopt it and how we earn their trust.
Meridian is part of Pilot, backed by more than $170 million in financing from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Stripe, Bezos Expeditions, and Whale Rock.

sections.title: About The Role
paras: As a Solutions Engineer, you are the accounting and technical authority in every Meridian sales cycle. You will partner with Account Executives on discovery calls with key accounting firm stakeholders, run product demos, lead Proof of Concepts using Meridian software to close prospective firm’s real client books, and stay with the account through implementation and its first close on Meridian as a customer.

Our buyers have spent their careers in the close. They will ask how Meridian handles a deferred revenue schedule, what happens to an intercompany elimination, how firm-level preferences interact with client-level overrides, and what the review layer shows them before anything reaches a client. Answering those questions credibly, in the moment and from experience, is the core of the job.
You will have a variable incentive plan tied to the performance of the Account Executives you support.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Partner with Account Executives across qualification, technical discovery, demo, evaluation, and close, working toward shared revenue targets.

Support discovery with client leadership to understand how a firm runs its close today, where capacity breaks down, what its portfolio mix looks like, and which ledgers and tools it has standardized on.

Run proof of concepts. You will scope success criteria with the firm, configure the environment against their real client data, run a live close, and walk the firm’s team through what the product did and the reasoning behind it.
Own the accounting answer in the room, covering revenue recognition, multi-entity consolidation, accrual and cash basis, chart of accounts conventions, close cutoffs, and clearing accounts.
Handle technical due diligence on ledger connectivity, supported integrations, data flows, permissions, firm and client-level configuration, and security and IT questionnaires.

Support implementation rollouts after signature by onboarding the firm’s client portfolio, configuring firm standards and client-level overrides, and getting the team through a successful first close.
Build reusable assets for the broader team, including demo environments, proof of concept scoping templates, objection handling guidance, and enablement material.
Bring structured feedback from the field back to Product so the roadmap reflects what firms are actually blocked on.

sections.title: What You’ll Bring
bullets: 3 to 5 years of public accounting experience in audit, assurance, tax, or client accounting services. You have either closed books or reviewed them and you know what a messy client looks like.
Command of the month-end close, including categorization, reconciliations, accruals, financial statement preparation, and the judgment calls that have no obvious right answer.
Credibility with firm leadership. Managing partners, firm controllers, and practice leads should come out of a call confident that you understand their work.
Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, or comparable ledgers, along with a working knowledge of the tools around them.

That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

sections.title: About the Product - Connect Platform
paras: Connect is Stripe’s platform for businesses that serve other businesses. It gives platforms the infrastructure to represent the people and companies in their ecosystem, onboard and verify them, manage their accounts, accept payments, and pay them out - without building payments, compliance, or financial-services systems themselves. This is how businesses like Shopify can help entrepreneurs run and grow their businesses. It is also the kind of infrastructure that marketplaces such as DoorDash need to coordinate money movement across large networks of restaurants, merchants, and dashers.

Connect has impact across industries. Shopify uses Stripe to embed financial services for merchants; Lugg streamlines worker onboarding and offers instant payouts; DoorLoop reduces manual customer onboarding tasks by nearly 50% with Stripe; and Sharetribe helps entrepreneurs launch and run marketplaces on Stripe.

AI is accelerating the emergence of entirely new business models: global networks of creators and experts, AI-native marketplaces, and agent-driven products that change how people discover, buy, sell, and deliver services. These businesses are more dynamic than traditional platforms: participants may operate across borders, take on different roles, and need new ways to establish trust, access financial capabilities, and get paid.

sections.title: Why this role
paras: This is a chance to define a foundational product area at Stripe. You will turn a fast-changing set of user and product needs into durable platform primitives that work across products, industries, and geographies.

The role combines high-leverage strategy with hands-on product execution. You will work through ambiguous, consequential questions like: what should a platform be able to model? What should be simple by default but flexible when needed? How can Stripe make complex financial infrastructure feel effortless for a platform and its users?

The outcome of your work will compound. The abstractions you help create will be reused across Connect and Stripe, shaping what new products platforms can build and how quickly they can bring them to market.

sections.title: What you’ll do
paras: We are looking for an entrepreneurial Product Manager to build the platform experiences behind Connect's next generation of users. You will own critical product primitives that platforms, including the fastest-growing AI companies, use to onboard, configure, and manage their users on Stripe. You will turn a clear strategic direction into products that solve hard user problems today while creating a coherent, extensible foundation for business models that are still being invented.

This role is for someone who enjoys the depth of platform work but is uncompromising about product craft and solving real user needs - both the ones users have today and will have in the future. The work is not building infra for its own sake; you will build capabilities that help our users launch a new marketplace, enable a global network to pay its contributors, or give a business entirely new ways for their end users to earn.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Bring the next generation of Connect accounts to life. Own key product areas within the account platform, translating strategy into a focused roadmap, crisp product decisions, and high-quality launches.

Build from use cases. Start with the real problems platforms face, such as onboarding a new seller, supporting a complex business model, or evolving a user's financial capabilities, and then work towards the primitives needed to solve them well.
Make sophisticated infrastructure feel simple. Partner with engineering and design to create API and product experiences that are powerful and intuitive.

See around corners. Develop a strong point of view on how AI will change platform economics, participant models, and financial workflows. Make focused foundational investments that unlock the next wave of demand.

Turn user signals into durable product investments. Work closely with users, Sales, Partnerships, and other Stripe teams to distinguish bespoke requests from patterns that should become scalable platform capabilities, connecting business needs, user needs, and platform evolution.

Drive high-velocity, high-craft execution and own outcomes. Lead cross-functional work from discovery through launch, and hold yourself accountable for developer experience, platform adoption, user value, and business impact, not simply features shipped.

sections.title: Who We Are

The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. sections.title: About the Role
paras: As the founding Senior Product Marketing Manager for Privacy and Data Security, you will play a central role in advancing Verkada’s core mission to protect people and places in a privacy-sensitive way by defining and driving our global privacy and data security narrative. These elements are never afterthoughts at Verkada; they are foundational to how we design our technology and a core differentiator that enables us to earn the trust of – and successfully sell to – some of the world’s largest organizations.

In this role, you will lead the charge in proactively establishing Verkada as the undisputed leader in how a cloud-first physical security company should approach privacy and data security. You will go incredibly deep into the weeds of our technical architecture, becoming a subject matter expert who can be strategically deployed to create customer-facing collateral, go toe-to-toe with technical experts and executive buyers, and evangelize our privacy and security posture across the entire go-to-market engine.

This role is deeply cross-functional and requires you to bring together stakeholders across the Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Communications teams. You will also partner closely with Verkada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and Chief Privacy Officer. This role will report into our Director of Product Marketing.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Serve as a cross-functional subject matter expert: Act as a definitive expert on data privacy across our product portfolio. Unite Marketing, Sales, and Product teams to drive commercial results, lead Executive Briefing Center (EBC) sessions, and directly empower our field organization to navigate complex technical privacy evaluations.

Enable the go-to-market engine: Partner closely with Sales, Demand Generation, Creative, and Channel Marketing teams to accelerate pipeline growth. Translate complex hardware capabilities and technical privacy frameworks into high-impact outbound marketing assets and field collateral that directly improve win rates.

Exceptional writing skills with meticulous attention to detail and ability to write content for a variety of audiences, including highly technical content

sections.title: About the Role
paras: This position sits on the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.

Verkada sells through partners. Two products carry that motion: the Verkada Store (vStore) , where partners quote, price, and order, and the Partner Portal , where partners run their Verkada business — registering deals, tracking orders and renewals, pulling pricebooks and inventory, requesting marketing funds, and reaching the training and enablement they need to sell. You own both. One partner experience, two surfaces.

Verkada's ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with, and the Store and the Portal are where that promise is either kept or broken. The bar is a system partners choose to use: intuitive enough to need almost no training, useful enough that nobody keeps a side spreadsheet, and scalable enough that order volume can grow faster than the supporting headcount growth.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.
Take full ownership of strategy, prioritization, PRDs, and user experience for both core partner platforms, from quote-to-order pathways to navigation and identity management.

Hold both products to a product standard, not an internal-tool standard. The honest measure is whether a partner would rather use the Store than call someone, and whether an internal user would rather use it than build a workaround.
Partner with Sales, Channel, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Deal Desk to translate needs into features and workflow changes across the full partner journey.

Talk to partners directly. Partner AEs, SEs, order admins, and finance admins each use these products differently, and the roadmap should reflect what they do, not what internal stakeholders assume they do.
Lead cross-functional requirements sessions to define functional scope. Surface the unspoken and conflicting requirements, and drive to a decision.

Directly impact key operational metrics—including board-level targets for self-service order adoption, reduced quote cycle times, straight-through order processing, and support ticket deflection across key partner personas.
Recommend changes to development and system standards that improve scalability and reduce maintenance burden.

bullets: Bachelor's degree in MIS, CS, Business, or other technical/analytical field.
Minimum 5+ years of experience, ideally including e-commerce, retail systems, or online storefront management.
Basic SQL, Python, JavaScript and HTML preferred.
Experience with marketplace platforms, channel programs, and multi-channel selling.
Familiarity with CPQ and quote-to-cash, discounting, payment processing, checkout flows, and order management systems.
Familiarity with pricing strategy concepts (e.g., tiered/volume pricing, promotions, bundling) and how they translate into system configuration.
Experience designing for multiple personas in a single product, where the same surface has to serve a seller, an admin, and a finance user without becoming a compromise for all three.
Exposure to inventory management, fulfillment/logistics, deal desk, sales operations, or revenue operations functions is a plus.
